items.name: Glimmer-Arrow Pendant
items.lore: A glimmer-glass arrowhead. It points toward the Glimmer King's hosts, wherever they are.

items.name: Elfshot Ward
items.lore: A healer's charm against the glimmer folk's arrows.

items.name: Madman's Bracer
items.lore: An elfshot man made this, in his madness. It's very good.

items.name: Glimmerling Cloak
items.lore: It catches the light and throws it back wrong.

items.name: Lurikeen Hearth-Charm
items.lore: A little clay figure of a hearth, made by lurikeen children.

items.name: Cleanser's Torc
items.lore: An Azure cleanser's torc. Every link has a name scratched into it - the names of the cleansed.

items.name: Pale Horse Bracer
items.lore: Leather from a pale horse of the hills. It never quite warms.

items.name: Exile's Cloak
items.lore: Grey and patched. Cnoc wore it for a year.

items.name: Inquisitor's Ring
items.lore: Taken from the Azure inquisitor who held the village.
